stories.title: The Road to Austin — What Every Championship Contender Must Do at COTA

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Nine days until Austin.

Antonelli leads by 102 with 156 points left. He can clinch at COTA.

Russell needs to win AND get help. Verstappen has won 2 in a row and won't stop.

The 2026 F1 title could be decided in Texas. #F1 #USGrandPrix

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
What Antonelli needs at COTA to clinch:

Win the race + build a 126-point gap after Austin.

He's 102 ahead now. One dominant weekend and this title is over. #F1 #F1Fanrecap
